snippet.title: Ledgerbound - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Sharpen your quills: Ledgerbound, the hilariously bureaucratic tactical RPG, launches July 14th! Wishlist today so you can save Heroes United Life Group *and* the world: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3315060/Ledgerbound/

Even Employee-of-Every-Month Rayna knows that love is worth fighting for!  You'll fall in love with these bachelors and bachelorettes on your journey to deny an insurance claim and save the world in this new trailer. In this employee review, we sat down with a few of the heroes you've been thirsting over and showed them some of your comments... 👀

The voices behind Heroes United Life Group's finest heroes and romantic interests:
👑 Smitten by the royal Prince Avarice? It's no wonder, thanks to Matt Mercer's performance
😏 Learn more about the dangerously intriguing and sultry Cazian, played by Ben Starr
📜 Climb to the top of the corporate ladder with your manager Jazz, played by Stephanie Kerbis
😈 Submit to the Shareholders' will! Etheria is brought to life by Caitlyn Elizabeth and Astros is played by Gabriel Michael
⚔️ Sweep a lovelorn knight off his feet: Pallas is played by Delbert Hunt
🤖 Get in touch with your feelings with Aura, played by Melissa Medina
🖤 Confront your fears with Joy, played by Shelby Young
🔥 Do you feel Sylvie's sweet flames of passion? Played by Cherami Leigh
🐀 Fall in love with the endearing Hobknob played by Todd Haberkorn
🎙️ ...all described in lurid detail by our Narrator Jeff Leach!
